opportunities.name: Movie night invite with IMDb + Rotten Tomatoes ratings
opportunities.description: For a given movie, look up the IMDb rating, director and runtime, then the Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer score, and write an email inviting a friend to movie night on a given day.
steps: On IMDb, click the search box, select all, type {movie_title} and press Enter
Open the matching title result and note the IMDb rating, director and runtime
On Rotten Tomatoes, search for {movie_title} and open the movie result
Note the Tomatometer score
In mail, open New message and enter {recipient_email} in To
Set Subject to 'Movie night {day}: {movie_title}'
Set Body to 'Hi {name}, {day} we watch {movie_title} ({director}, {runtime}): IMDb {imdb_rating}, Tomatometer {tomatometer}%.'
Send the message (the user clicked Discard in the recording)

instances.values: Arrival; lena@example.com; Friday; Denis Villeneuve, 1h 56m, IMDb 7.9, RT 94%
Spirited Away; tom@example.com; Saturday; Hayao Miyazaki, 2h 4m, IMDb 8.6, RT 96%
The Grand Budapest Hotel; aisha@example.com; Sunday; Wes Anderson, 1h 39m, IMDb 8.1, RT 92%

opportunities.name: npm package health summary to notes
opportunities.description: For a given npm package, collect the latest version, weekly downloads and license from npm, then the stars, open issues and last release date from its GitHub repo, and save a one-line summary note.
steps: On npmjs.com, click the search box, select all, type {package} and press Enter
Open the exact-match package result
Note the version, weekly downloads and license
Click the GitHub repository link
Note the stars and open issues, then click Releases and note the latest release date
In Notes, type '{package}: v{version}, {downloads}/week, {license}, {stars} stars, {issues} open issues, last release {date}' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Recipe + origin research note
opportunities.description: For a given dish and number of servings, find the top Allrecipes recipe (rating, total time, first ingredients), look up the dish's place of origin on Wikipedia, and save a note.
steps: On Allrecipes, click the search box, select all, type {dish} and press Enter
Open the top recipe result
Note the rating, total time and the first three ingredients for {servings} servings
On Wikipedia, search {dish} and open the article
Read the infobox 'Place of origin'
In Notes, type '{dish} for {servings}: {recipe_name} ({rating} stars, {time}), needs {ingredients}. Origin: {origin}' and press Enter
